t: Versatile twin pack comprised of a combi drill and impact driver. Both tools feature all-metal gearboxes and bright white LED work lights. Combi drill features 15-position adjustable torque settings with screwdriving, drill driving and hammer settings for a wide range of applications. Impact driver features a compact and lightweight design, ideal for use in confined spaces. Heat dispersion offered by the aluminium front housing increases motor life and the drop-in keyless hex driver allows for quick, one-handed fitment. Supplied with multi-voltage charger and TSTAK Kitbox.
